$comment: Hand-written source for the catalog's patterns, layouts and templates (and components, when the project has no meta.json). build-catalog.mjs merges it into catalog.json. IDs never change and are never reused: a replaced entry keeps its ID with status "deprecated" and a replacedBy. Delete the three example entries below.

statuses.draft: Exists in the product, not written down as a shared pattern.
statuses.in-review: Documented as the shared pattern, not yet measured in the browser.
statuses.stable: Documented and verified in the browser.

entries.name: App shell
entries.description: What it is, in one sentence a designer would say.

entries.name: Record list
entries.description: Listing screen: toolbar, summary row, table, pagination, empty state.
entries.note: Optional. Anything a reader must know before reusing it; shown on the card.

entries.name: Status pill
entries.description: Old value struck through, arrow, new value.
